body.statement: Conditional on \((M,\Omega)\), fixed \(q\), uniform sub-Gaussian moments, row-law factorization, conditional within-row block dependence, variance nondegeneracy, and the derived score-diffuseness bounds imply \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n}\sup_{z\in\mathbb R}|\mathbb P_P(L/s\le z\mid M,\Omega)-\Phi(z)|\to0\).
body.justification: A uniform dependency-graph Lyapunov argument derives the Gaussian limit from primitive dependence, moments, and diffuse weights.
body.gap: Existing serial factor central limit theorems do not cover this three-block influence array under deterministic causal-block masking.
body.consumer: The Wald theorem uses this derived score limit instead of assuming asymptotic normality.
